title: Studies on the Tribocorrosion Properties of an Iron Alloy Produced by Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing Subjected to Multi-Stage Heat Treatment
content: The paper addresses tribocorrosion resistance studies of components made from the iron alloy Fe (0.21% C, 0.8% Si, 1.29% Mn, 1.34% Cr) using the Wire Arc Additive Manufactur-ing (WAAM) technology. The authors have developed their original heat treatment tech-nology where oil baths are used, leading to an increase in impact strength. This treatment combines processes such as austenitising, martensitic hardening, tempering, and aus-tempering. As part of the research tests, tribocorrosion wear measurements were con-ducted in a 3.5% NaCl solution on both heat-treated and non-treated samples. The meas-urements showed lower tribocorrosion wear in the samples subjected to the novel heat treatment.
